author: claude
description: Carts that are abandoned keep their stock held forever, so popular items show as sold out while nobody is buying them. This gives every reservation an `expiresAt` (15 minutes by default, configurable via `ttlMs`), adds `releaseExpired()` to return expired holds to stock, a small `startSweeper()` that runs it on an interval, and calls it at the start of checkout so a cart cannot buy stock whose hold already lapsed. Tests cover expiry timing and checkout dropping a lapsed line.

defects.mechanism: releaseExpired selects reservations by expiresAt alone and never checks status, but committed, released, and already-expired records stay in the map (by design, for order support). Every sweep therefore unholds them again, driving `held` negative and making `available` exceed real stock, so the storefront oversells; since checkout also sweeps, every checkout after the TTL compounds it.
